title: Microphone and truck noise
summary: Russell adjusts the microphone because of passing trucks; talk of street noise and Robinson's 26 years there.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Just a minute. I'll point this microphone, this, all the big trucks have figured out what that hum is now.
You can set the door if you want.
Well, maybe we better a little bit. Just see if it won't be too warm for you.
No, it ain't going to be too warm for me. As far as we don't set that far. Because all those trucks make sort of a hum going.
That's what I said. The windows open anyway.

Red Becker was talking the other day. He came over here and said there's such a much truck noise all night. He said he didn't think anybody could sleep on this street. I guess you get used to it. Oh, yeah. I've been here 26 years. I've been getting used to it. It doesn't bother me. There used to be where there's a lot of cars going by now. But Jack's blue. He didn't bother. Excuse the interruption. That'll pick it up better now.
